title: ExecutionProfile
description: Two independently referenceable shapes for the execution profile: the logical profile reference as it appears in a plan, and the resolved snapshot produced by the worker after compiling the plan.

ExecutionProfileRef.title: ExecutionProfileRef
ExecutionProfileRef.description: The logical profile as it appears in a plan. A single required string field identifies the versioned policy to apply. Note: in a plan the enclosing task field may carry this as a bare string value (e.g. "executionProfile": "backend-balanced-v1") rather than as a wrapped object; both representations are semantically equivalent.

name.description: Logical profile name, e.g. 'backend-balanced-v1'. Must be a versioned policy identifier resolvable by the worker at compile time.

ExecutionProfileSnapshot.title: ExecutionProfileSnapshot
ExecutionProfileSnapshot.description: The resolved snapshot produced by the worker when it compiles a plan. Freezes all routing decisions so the execution record is self-contained and auditable.

engine.description: The engine selected for this task. Matches one of the engines ai-code-worker's 'doctor' command supports (today: 'claude', 'codex'). An open string rather than a closed enum so that adding a new engine to worker does not require a schema version bump.

resolvedModel.description: The effective model identifier for this task — never an alias such as 'claude' or 'codex' alone. Must be the full, versioned model ID (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'gpt-4o-2024-08-06'). This rule matches planningProvenance's panelMembers[].resolvedModel: comparable routing-outcome data requires snapshots to carry the concrete identifier, not a shorthand that resolves differently across time.

fallbacks.description: Ordered list of fallback engine identifiers. Each entry must be resolvable by the worker's doctor at the time the plan is compiled.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this engine and model were selected.

confidence.description: Confidence score for this routing decision, in the range [0, 1] inclusive.

policyVersion.description: Identifier of the routing policy version used to resolve this profile.
